name: Monolithic Power Systems

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Monolithic Power Systems Logo.svg)

description: Monolithic Power Systems is a fabless designer of power-management chips and modules: it converts and regulates electricity inside computers, servers, cars, communications gear and appliances, and sells them mostly through three distributors (26, 18 and 10 percent of 2025 revenue). It reports one segment. Storage and computing (memory, SSDs, notebooks, graphics cards) and enterprise data (servers and AI systems) were the two largest markets in 2025, and enterprise data jumped to 38.8 percent of revenue in Q2 2026 as revenue rose 47.6 percent year on year. It has raised its quarterly dividend from $1.56 to $2.00 (February 2026).

businessLines.name: Storage and Computing
businessLines.how: Power chips sold per unit, through distributors, into PC, memory and graphics designs; revenue follows device builds.
businessLines.description: Power for memory, storage solutions, notebooks and graphics cards.

businessLines.name: Enterprise Data
businessLines.how: Power chips and modules sold per unit into server and AI-system designs; a few large customers dominate, and revenue swings with AI server build cycles.
businessLines.description: Power for cloud and on-premises CPU servers, workstations and AI systems.

businessLines.name: Automotive
businessLines.how: Power chips sold per unit to car makers and Tier 1s for multi-year vehicle programs.
businessLines.description: Advanced driver assistance, infotainment, USB connectors, body electronics, motion control and lighting.

businessLines.name: Communications
businessLines.how: Power chips sold per unit into network and optical-module designs.
businessLines.description: Network infrastructure, satellite communications, optical modules and switches.

businessLines.name: Consumer
businessLines.how: Power chips sold per unit into consumer product designs.
businessLines.description: Home appliances, gaming, smart TVs, lighting, monitors and stereos.

businessLines.name: Industrial
businessLines.how: Power chips sold per unit into industrial equipment designs.
businessLines.description: Power sources, industrial meters, security and other industrial equipment.
